notes.title: v0.5.2 update
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
-Now you can set game as fullscreen or windows.
-Now you can adjust music or SFX.

notes.title: v0.5.1 update
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
-Now you can invite you steam friend to battle together more easily.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
-Fix the collider issue for orc shaman and warlock.

notes.title: v0.5.0 Emotion system added
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]
-Emotion System, now you can send emote to opponent with "~".

[h2]Balance[/h2]
-Orc Shaman 1) hp reduced a little 2)attack speed reduced a little 3)attack damage reduced a little
-Orc Warlock 1)attack speed reduced a little 2)attack damage reduced a little

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
-Fix undead base animation issue when Lv3.

notes.title: v0.4.1 Hot fix
